decisions.reason: The firm is growing and has slack, and the enclosed laser workstation line builds on its core laser marking competence, so a one-year-old product with uncertain results does not trigger problemistic search and will be carried forward.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the established coding portfolio, has its own web page, and costs little to maintain in a growing industry, so management sees no shortfall against aspirations that would justify dropping it.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal inkjet model and supports the single-source, surface-matched offer, and with expansion-level slack the firm can keep it while market results develop.
